name: bow_a
about: R2-DECK-LAYOUT re-plan (D-94) candidate A, the bow stage: the navigation arc at the bow rail on the centreline (r 17.5, bearings -16/0/+16) with its operator facing the bow (use point r 15); the captain's chair behind it; the Voyage and Crew consoles flanking (bearings -34 and +32), operators stern of their desks facing the bow; the spawn behind the helm on the centreline; the Archive at the mast unchanged; the rim frond under the starbow's centre (+10 deg) moved to +25 deg to pair with -25; conduits re-aimed at the moved stations. Blockout for search and review only: the Blender export is the source of truth. DL1: the chair keeps the walk 0.5 m from its plan rectangle (walk_clear_m), so its high back never hides a captain standing right behind it (camera-test AC1 at the Z1/Z3 developer presets). DL1: the Voyage and Crew desks sit 0.6 m further bow-ward than the plan, so their operators (at the plan's use points) stand 2.0 m stern of the desk centre, as grounded v2 placed them: ShipConsoles' idle screen then sits in front of the desk, not inside it (at 1.4 m the plan buried it), and the Crew operator keeps the lift off the Bow line.
frame: ship metres, Blender +Z up; glTF (x, z, -y); the bow is ship +y (glTF -z)
consoles_under_screens: R3-COMMS-V2 revision 3 (Mark, 2026-11-03: 'can we move the consoles to be underneath the screens? yes will need model updates I guess'): the Voyage, comms and crew desks stand at the bow rail walkway (r 18.6 m) under their monitors of wall R (Voyage under Earth's clock at -48 deg, comms under the signal from home at -30 deg, crew under the crew faces at +48 deg), each turned so its operator (1.225 m inboard) faces the screen; yaw = -90 - bearing. The helm stays central beside the course screen. Measured in-engine (design r3/comms-station-v2.md §D2): every evaluator metric equals the previous bridge, every operator point walkable and reachable. The floor conduits that ran to the Voyage, crew and comms desks turn about the mast to their new bearings (v2_conduit_00 -48, v2_conduit_01 +48, v2_conduit_02 -30; yaw = base bearing - new bearing). The port watch bench (v2_bench_detail_02 with watch_bench_2) stays where it is, between the Voyage and comms desks; the walk around it was measured open.
operator_contact: D-132: Voyage/Crew real working points advance 0.775 m toward the unchanged desks. The original screen housings are separately anchored in the manifest; the historical DL1 two-metre spacing rationale above no longer controls captain placement.
